q: Preorder of the tree 1 (left 2, right 3), where 2 has left child 4?
why: Node, then the whole left subtree (2, 4), then the right subtree (3).

q: Which traversal processes both children before the parent?
why: Postorder is the natural order for "compute from children, then combine".

q: Recursive DFS on a completely skewed tree of n nodes uses how much stack space?
why: The recursion goes n levels deep. For a balanced tree it's O(log n).

q: Path Sum: why check `not node.left and not node.right` before comparing the sum?
options: Only leaves may end a root-to-leaf path
why: A node with one child isn't a leaf; stopping there would count a path that doesn't reach a leaf.
